metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow landed 1 poor soul? Valorant madness!
metadata.description:
Tapping like I was chasing invisible enemies.
Enemy probably rethinking their career choices.
Did NOT deserve that lucky shot but hey, chaos loves me!
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you.

Click if your aim’s mostly accidental chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
